messages.NEW: SafarSet: your new journey is arranged. Take {vehicle}. Board at {boarding}. Departs {depart}; arrives {dest} at {arrive}. Group of {size}. Reason: {reason}.
messages.CHANGED: SafarSet: your journey has CHANGED. Take {vehicle}. Board at {boarding}. Departs {depart}; arrives {dest} at {arrive}. Group of {size}. Reason: {reason}.
messages.DISPLACED_UNPLACED: SafarSet: your earlier seat is no longer available. We are finding another option and will message you again. Reason: {reason}.
messages.FALLBACK: SafarSet: your journey details have been updated. Please check with the control room.

decided_by.EARLIEST_ARRIVAL: it is the earliest arrival we could offer
decided_by.ONLY_FEASIBLE_OPTION: it was the only option that fits your group
decided_by.CLASS_STEP: arrivals within 15 minutes count as equal, and this one keeps you closest to your ticket class
decided_by.UPGRADE_DISTANCE: arrivals within 15 minutes count as equal, and this one needs the smaller upgrade
decided_by.BEST_FIT: arrivals within 15 minutes count as equal, and this vehicle fits your group best
decided_by.ARRIVAL: arrivals within 15 minutes count as equal, and this one arrives earlier
decided_by.MODE_TIER: options were equal, so a train was preferred
decided_by.DEFAULT: it was the best option available for your group

class_step.UPGRADE: your seat is in a higher class than your ticket
class_step.LOWER_CLASS_FLAGGED: NOTE: your seat is in a lower class than your ticket
class_step.UNRESERVED_LAST_RESORT: no reserved seat was free in time, so this is unreserved space

reasons.reshuffle_moved: your vehicle was changed to make room for another passenger; your arrival moves by {delta} min
reasons.reshuffle_made_room: seats were made available by moving other passengers who lose nothing

causes.LOAD_REPORT: the vehicle was too crowded to board
causes.OPERATOR_OVERRIDE: the control room changed your journey
